title: Launch ownership matrix and release-note automation runway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Create a single ownership matrix and an automated release-note pipeline for the Q2 release train spanning API, Console, and Runtime. This ticket covers ownership assignments by feature area, cut/scope-lock dates, automated extraction of PR-level changelogs into the release-note template, and the operational runway for signoffs (engineering, QA, product, docs, marketing). Goal is to reduce manual churn producing release notes, prevent missed callouts, and ensure GTM has finalized messaging 48 hours prior to public release windows.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Owner assigned for every top-line feature listed in the release train matrix
A2: Release-note automation pipeline extracts merged PR titles + linked changelog blocks and generates draft RN in Confluence/Drive
A3: All sections (API, Console, Runtime, Breaking Changes, Known Issues, Migration Notes, Security Notes) have designated approvers
A4: Scope-lock and final-cut calendar entries published and visible in org calendar
A5: GTM message package (one-pager + release highlights) approved 72 hours before public rollout
tasks: Define feature-area buckets and map active PRs by tag (area/api, area/console, area/runtime)
Build Confluence template for automated RN drafts with standardized headings and link placeholders for demos/PRs
Implement lightweight pipeline: on merge, collect PR data (title, description, changelog block, author) -> append to draft RN page
Set scope-lock date (2026-03-25) and final-cut date (2026-04-05); create calendar invites for teams
Assign owners for each RN section and schedule signoff windows
Coordinate with Marketing for GTM bundle and support assets (release blog, one-pager, product screenshots)
Run a dry-run: simulate RN generation for the previous minor release to validate formatting and owner workflow
Document rollback/cut criteria for release notes and public comms if regressions discovered

notes: Decision trade-offs: We will not block the entire release train for a single non-critical API change; instead, owner must opt into a targeted rollback for that component
Cut Criteria (summary): regressions >5% p50 latency OR data-corrupting bug -> block public release; any security finding with severity >= high -> block until fixed and security-signed
Embargo policy: All public messaging must be finalized by GTM 72 hours pre-release; marketing embargo exceptions require VP approval
Fallback: If RN automation fails, maintain manual template in Docs team repo as backup
Follow-up: Post-release RN cleanup task to reconcile auto-collected PRs with final human-authored narrative
